daf5d0bba95e5c69ac54f724bc6c3bce817ab84e.pinyin: tā zuò de ròu jiàng yǒu yì diǎn là.

daf83d7d2c8d0faeb4e98462ea942f0e48f19f6b.pinyin: jīng lǐ chì zé le nà ge zhèng zhòng jī zhuō zi de nán zǐ.
daf83d7d2c8d0faeb4e98462ea942f0e48f19f6b.text: 经理斥责了那个正重击桌子的男子。

dafac0435ae61a6f7a271911941b45c7838a9028.pinyin: dì zhèn shí shí kè kè dōu yǒu kě néng fā shēng.
dafac0435ae61a6f7a271911941b45c7838a9028.text: 地震时时刻刻都有可能发生。

dafc427519502a6e58395b9e122997683ac2c2c5.pinyin: wǒ lǎo gōng jīn tiān zuò wǎn fàn.

dafc7351e63dd8ba8b81fd868e349ded7d447955.pinyin: Tā yóu yù le yí huì er, cái dā ying yāo qǐng.
dafc7351e63dd8ba8b81fd868e349ded7d447955.text: 她犹豫了一会儿，才答应邀请。

dafe0bf2d525674204a111db9b2dc3e336ebcd00.pinyin: tā men bǎ tā fèng wèi lǐng xiù.

dafe3a09cf8299433402c6661dc40ba563d06c4c.pinyin: gǔ shū zhōng, huái shēn jiù shì yǒu yùn.

dafec49290352f796f01e6dfc6d46e0e9d08768c.pinyin: tā xī wàng píng zì jǐ de nǔ lì chū rén tóu dì.
dafec49290352f796f01e6dfc6d46e0e9d08768c.text: 她希望凭自己的努力出人头地。
